reusable_mechanisms.path: library/kernel/tools/operation.py (run L465-539, _publish L542-551, _finish L554-577, recover L582-649, status L409-437, read_pending L365-406, acquire/flock L192-304, request_hash L455-460, replay+effects_present L477-489)
reusable_mechanisms.validates: Observable atomicity of a multi-file write set: intent marker before publish, temp+rename per file, verify digests, receipt, then remove marker. Refuses BASE_CHANGED (expected digests), PENDING_EXISTS, RECEIPT_MISMATCH (same op id, different payload), THIRD_STATE (file changed outside during pending), STAGING_INCOMPLETE/STAGING_CORRUPT (all checked before any target moves), PENDING_UNREADABLE (distinct from absent), LOCK_ACTIVE/LOCK_UNDETERMINED. Idempotent replay returns the prior receipt plus effects_present.
scenarios: T11 STALE_INPUT (for files in the write set): BASE_CHANGED L500-508
T12 crash at each publish boundary: pending marker + recover roll-forward L582-649
T13 repeated op after success: receipt replay L477-489
T14 two sessions, same base: flock exclusion + BASE_CHANGED
T17 partial: THIRD_STATE keeps the direct edit, never overwrites it
T39 pattern: sha256 byte digests L182-187
F2 item 3: carrier for checkpoint publication (plan 01 says reuse it as the only publisher)
reusable_mechanisms.limitations: write_set values are text only, encoded utf-8 (L516-519), so no binary artefacts. No delete operation: migrate.py L418-425 states the limit. The lock lives in $TMP on the local FS; NFS or no fcntl falls back to create-exclusive (L49-51, L79). 'expected' covers only files being written, not read-only inputs, so a real read-set (T10) must be layered on top. No draft/received/integrated result states (T15). recover only rolls forward.
reusable_mechanisms.verdict: KEEP as the single publication mechanism; EXTEND for checkpoint and read-set preconditions (F2). Verified by reading.

reusable_mechanisms.validates: The denominator is derived from files, never from the reviewer's record. There is a per-stage basis (reconciliation / blueprint / render) with byte digests plus semantic fingerprints (NFC, collapsed whitespace). Freshness is current or stale with reasons (source added/removed/changed, authority changed, target changed or missing). An unsupported contract_version is not read as stale. Every source-review entry needs a rationale; 'unverifiable' needs reason/impact/action. Obligations cannot vanish between stages (COV-UNREVIEWED); not_selected needs a reason. A semantic review needs performed_by (agent|human), method, both passes, limitations and findings. not_evaluated is never a pass. finalize publishes a new version only on a current basis and re-checks at the end.

T42 (semantic fingerprint vs byte digest; graph consumed subset)
reusable_mechanisms.limitations: The coverage unit is source units, SU/decision refs and targets. There are no six-lens dimensions (assessed/gap/not_applicable) and no FC/WP ids.
